proposals.before: I hear that your commandery head once temporized and bowed north to Yan Ya’s teeth, then afterward came to awareness and dwelt in retirement cultivating virtue.
proposals.after: I hear that your commandery head once temporized and bowed north to Yan Ya, then afterward came to awareness and dwelt in retirement cultivating virtue.
proposals.reason: 延牙 is the personal name Yan Ya (alternate designation of Yan Cen), not the common noun 'teeth'.

decisions.reason: In 北面延牙, 延牙 is the personal name Yan Ya (also used for Yan Cen), not 牙 as 'teeth'; the literal wrongly appends 'teeth' to the name, and the proposed removal restores the sense.
